_comment: FIXTURE — stands in for the live NDMA SACHET CAP feed when it is unreachable (see ../govtAlerts.ts). Shapes/wording mirror real IMD/CWC/SDMA CAP messages for NER.

alerts.headline: Orange alert: heavy to very heavy rainfall over Dima Hasao, Cachar, Karbi Anglong
alerts.description: Heavy to very heavy rainfall very likely at isolated places over Dima Hasao, Cachar and Karbi Anglong districts of Assam during next 24 hours. Landslides likely in hilly areas.

alerts.headline: Brahmaputra above danger level at Dibrugarh; Neamatighat rising
alerts.description: River Brahmaputra flowing above danger level at Dibrugarh (DBR) and Neamatighat (Jorhat). Rising trend expected for 24 h. Low-lying areas and riverine roads may be inundated.

alerts.headline: Landslide warning: East Jaintia Hills and West Khasi Hills
alerts.description: Slope instability reported along NH-6 and state highways after 48 h of continuous rain. Avoid night travel; heavy vehicles restricted on Jowai–Khliehriat stretch.

alerts.headline: Yellow alert: thunderstorm and gusty winds over Manipur and Mizoram
alerts.description: Thunderstorm accompanied with lightning and gusty winds (30-40 kmph) likely at isolated places over Manipur and Mizoram.
